files.title: File:Peoples Banking and Trust Building, Putnam Street and 2nd Street, Marietta, OH (54323328669).jpg
files.author: Warren LeMay from Chicago, IL, United States
files.caption: Built in 1923, this Renaissance Revival-style building was built for the Peoples Banking and Trust Company, founded in 1902.  The building is clad in bedford limestone with large arched bays flanked by ionic columns on the first floor, replacement windows on the upper floors, cornices with dentils, and a rooftop stone balustrade.  The building is a contributing structure in the Marietta Historic District, listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1974, and expanded to its present siz
